flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper,download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper}, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/schedulers/{MhaDownloadJobsScheduler,ToppanUploadJobsScheduler}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, resources/{cron-schedules-prod,application-prod}.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant to this story
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. The story asks that after the e-reminder referring to the 2nd letter is sent (or the offender opted out), OCMS runs the particulars checks and updates (Epic OCMS8) so the 3rd letter (DR3) can be sent. In the code this is not one chain: eNotification, MHA upload/download, DataHive UEN/FIN and Toppan are separate crons that do not wait for each other. The selection of DR3 notices for MHA (NRIC offenders) and the mha_reg address saving run and are enabled in prod; three things lower the claim: (1) the eNotification job and SMS are off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, application-prod.properties:87), so the e-reminder only goes through the manual trigger; (2) the DataHive UEN/FIN job for FIN/company offenders is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52); (3) the 3rd letter does not wait for the check and its generation only runs through the manual trigger (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118). The demo remark mentions Vault and permission for the api App Service: cannot verify from repo. MHA/DataHive responses and real server property values: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: the MHA check and address saving run in prod, but the e-reminder, DataHive FIN/UEN and 3rd letter generation are off or manual. The check-then-letter order is not guaranteed by the code

steps.step: The individual offender receives an electronic reminder (SMS) that refers to the 2nd letter (DN2)
steps.detail: The eNotification job selects notices with last stage DN2 (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:161-162), prepares contacts (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188) and sends the SMS batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-292). Partial because the job is off in prod (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; manual trigger only, CombinedSchedulerTriggerController.java:105-108) and sms.enable=false in prod (application-prod.properties:87). Selection and sending details: see OCMS13.12 and OCMS13.13. Real server values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: An offender who has opted out of electronic reminders is excluded (checked, not sent)
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1135); the job loads the whole exclusion list once (loadAllExcludedIds, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1213) and skips excluded records or id_type P/PASSPORT before the SMS batch is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241). The logic is right, but it runs inside the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), hence Sebagian. One thing to watch: loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails (fail-open, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1213), although the filter inside the reminder query still screens first. The content of the exclusion list is DB data: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notices with an NRIC offender (id_type N) soon due for the 3rd letter (stage DR3) are selected for a particulars check at MHA
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN ('RD1','RD2','RR3','DN1','DN2','DR3') and next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type = 'N', offender_indicator = 'Y', outside ocms_nro_temp and HST (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581); it is called through MhaNricDataHelper.queryMhaNricData (MhaNricDataHelper.java:81). The MHA Upload cron is enabled in prod, Monday to Saturday at 09:00, 14:00 and 21:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). A UPL notice whose next stage is DR3 is picked one day before it is due. MHA's response and file intake: cannot verify from repo. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-133 and OCMS-DF-2026-125/126 (all Closed, Prod deployed) fixed PS/HST notices wrongly entering the queue.

steps.step: Offenders with a FIN or a company ID (id_type F/B) have their particulars checked through DataHive before the 3rd letter
steps.detail: findNoticesForDataHiveEnrichment / the query in DataHiveUenFinService selects notices with next stage IN (RD1..DR3), id_type IN ('F','B'), offender_indicator 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:528-554; DataHiveUenFinService.java:226-246). But MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.executeMhaDownloadJobs skips the DataHive UEN/FIN job when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:101-107), and that property is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52; properties comment: 'Keep disabled in PROD until DataHive view names are verified'). So the FIN/UEN offender check does not run in prod. The DataHive view names and their results: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The latest address from the MHA check is saved as the offender's address and used for the letter
steps.detail: When MHA results are processed, the address from the result file is written as an ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver_addr row with type_of_address 'mha_reg' and letter_address 'Y' only when no other row already holds 'Y' (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:2320-2336); Toppan reads addresses with mha_reg first (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:616-641). The MHA Download cron is enabled in prod, Monday to Saturday at 11:30, 16:30 and 23:30 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-130 (old mha_reg address not cleared, Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-177 (MHA result processed without checking the offender indicator, Closed); OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamps not updated, Ready to UAT) concerns audit timestamps only. The content of the MHA result file: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Checked notices become ready for the 3rd letter reminder/notification (next stage DR3)
steps.detail: Toppan selects notices with next_processing_stage = 'DR3' and next_processing_date <= today (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:585-614; ToppanUploadJob.java:248). There is no condition that the e-reminder was sent or that the MHA/DataHive check for that notice has finished: the eNotification, MHA, DataHive and Toppan crons stand alone and are ordered only by schedule. Letter generation itself only runs through the manual trigger because executeJob() is commented out at ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 (POST /toppan/generate-letters, ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-43). So 'check first, then the 3rd letter' is not guaranteed by the code. DR3 letter delivery details: see OCMS13.15.
